clementine.usage: The main action in a view or region — the one thing you most want the user to do. This is the token a designer means when they say "the primary colour".
clementine.notFor: Destructive actions (use action.destructive), brand marks (use accent.brand), or decorative fills.

clementine.usage: Hover state for the main action.
clementine.notFor: Hover state for destructive or secondary controls.

clementine.usage: Pressed state for the main action.
clementine.notFor: Pressed state for destructive or secondary controls.

clementine.usage: Background marking an item as currently selected in a list, table, or nav.
clementine.notFor: Hover-only feedback, or primary action fills.

clementine.usage: Hover state for an already-selected item.
clementine.notFor: Hover state for unselected items (use surface.subtle-hover).

clementine.usage: Irreversible or hard-to-undo actions: delete, revoke, terminate, force-disconnect.
clementine.notFor: Primary or default actions, emphasis, decoration, or anything a user can simply undo.

clementine.usage: Hover state for an irreversible action.
clementine.notFor: Hover state for any non-destructive control.

clementine.usage: Communicating that something failed or is invalid.
clementine.notFor: Destructive controls (use action.destructive), or risk severity (use risk.*).

clementine.usage: Low-emphasis backgrounds behind an error message.
clementine.notFor: Foreground text or icons — contrast is not guaranteed.

clementine.usage: Communicating that something completed or validated.
clementine.notFor: Positive decoration or brand accent.

clementine.usage: Low-emphasis backgrounds behind a success message.
clementine.notFor: Foreground text or icons — contrast is not guaranteed.

clementine.usage: Communicating a caution the user should read before acting.
clementine.notFor: Errors (use feedback.error) or risk severity (use risk.*).

clementine.usage: Low-emphasis backgrounds behind a warning message.
clementine.notFor: Foreground text or icons — contrast is not guaranteed.

clementine.usage: Scoring or classifying an asset, finding, or session at critical severity.
clementine.notFor: Operation outcomes (use feedback.*) or destructive controls (use action.destructive).

clementine.usage: Low-emphasis background for a critical-severity indicator.
clementine.notFor: Foreground text or icons — contrast is not guaranteed.

clementine.usage: Scoring or classifying at high severity.
clementine.notFor: Operation outcomes (use feedback.*).

clementine.usage: Low-emphasis background for a high-severity indicator.
clementine.notFor: Foreground text or icons — contrast is not guaranteed.

clementine.usage: Scoring or classifying at medium severity.
clementine.notFor: Operation outcomes (use feedback.*).

clementine.usage: Low-emphasis background for a medium-severity indicator.
clementine.notFor: Foreground text or icons — contrast is not guaranteed.

clementine.usage: Scoring or classifying at low severity.
clementine.notFor: Operation outcomes (use feedback.*).

clementine.usage: Low-emphasis background for a low-severity indicator.
clementine.notFor: Foreground text or icons — contrast is not guaranteed.
